DRAFT FOR REVIEW

CONFIDENTIAL CASE BRIEF FOR LEGAL REVIEW

From: [SENDER NAME AND ADDRESS]
To: [RECIPIENT NAME AND ADDRESS]

Subject: Time-barred claim (limitation)

MATERIAL FACTS

1. Sheela Narayan says that eight years ago she lent 2,00,000 to her cousin, Mohan Das, to help him open a small shop. Mohan promised to repay in two years. He made no payment, and Sheela did not push him because of family ties. Recently, when she asked again, Mohan said "that was a long time ago, and I don't owe you anything." She now wants to file a case to recover the money plus interest.

2. Sheela says Mohan acknowledged the debt on several occasions, including a family gathering about five years ago where he said, "I'll return it once the shop picks up," and a message about three years ago saying "give me some time, I haven't forgotten." She has been told the claim might be too old, and she wants to know whether it is already barred, whether the acknowledgments restart the clock, and whether there is any value in trying at all.

OUTCOME SOUGHT AND QUESTIONS FOR COUNSEL

[Specify the requested action or relief]

ENCLOSURES

None
